# Long test script

A: Turn one, speaker A opens the conversation.

B: Turn two, speaker B responds with a counterpoint.

A: Turn three, speaker A reframes the topic.

B: Turn four, speaker B offers an analogy.

A: Turn five, speaker A asks a clarifying question.

B: Turn six, speaker B answers carefully.

A: Turn seven, speaker A introduces a new angle.

B: Turn eight, speaker B explores the angle.

A: Turn nine, speaker A challenges the framing.

B: Turn ten, speaker B defends the framing.

A: Turn eleven, speaker A proposes a synthesis.

B: Turn twelve, speaker B accepts the synthesis.

A: Turn thirteen, speaker A summarizes the agreement.

B: Turn fourteen, speaker B adds a caveat.

A: Turn fifteen, speaker A closes the conversation.
